bullets: Removed the GPT-6 Luna model from the scheduled free retirement list, allowing continued use in the free picker.
Updated the CLI model picker to show the actual charge or the word Free when a solo session discount applies.
Fixed the AI assistant to accept common alternate names for file text fields and limit web searches to two extra keywords.
Improved Windows file location detection so the assistant can read project and external files without guessing.
Added support for recognizing lists of edits sent as a single text block, correcting the format before running commands.
Changed referral rewards from unlocking a specific model to adding hours to the Freebucks wallet for any model.
Restricted GPT-6 Luna access to paid plans and moved it to the top of the Powerful section in the model picker.
Updated the CLI input box to stop mouse movement signals from leaking in as stray characters during typing.
Updated button text in in-app ads to specific actions like Browse templates or Connect Gmail instead of generic verbs.
